lines.name: Mike
lines.en: Good evening! Welcome. How many people?

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: Sure! This way, please. Is this table OK?
lines.ko: 네! 이쪽으로 오세요. 이 자리 괜찮으세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Can I sit by the window?

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: Of course! Here's a window table. And here's the menu. Can I get you something to drink?
lines.ko: 물론이죠! 여기 창가 자리예요. 메뉴판도 드릴게요. 마실 것 좀 드릴까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like a cold beer, please.

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: One cold beer, coming right up! Are you ready to order?
lines.ko: 시원한 맥주 한 잔, 바로 드릴게요! 주문하시겠어요?

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: A small potato pizza. Great choice! Would you like a salad with that?
lines.ko: 감자 피자 작은 거요. 잘 고르셨어요! 샐러드도 같이 드릴까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like a seafood salad with that, please.

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: One seafood salad. Do you have any allergies?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I don't have any allergies. I love seafood. It goes great with beer.
lines.ko: 아니요, 알레르기 없어요. 해산물을 정말 좋아해요. 맥주랑 잘 어울리거든요.

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: I agree! I'll bring your beer first. Here's your pizza and salad. How is everything?
lines.ko: 맞아요! 맥주 먼저 갖다 드릴게요. 피자랑 샐러드 나왔습니다. 음식은 괜찮으세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Everything is good. Could I have another beer, please?
lines.ko: 다 맛있어요. 맥주 한 잔 더 주시겠어요?

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: Sure! One more cold beer for you. Would you like any dessert?
lines.ko: 네! 시원한 맥주 한 잔 더요. 디저트도 드릴까요?

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: No problem! Would you like the check?

lines.name: Mike
lines.en: Here's your check. You can pay at the counter. Thank you for coming. Have a good night!
lines.ko: 계산서 여기 있습니다. 계산은 카운터에서 하시면 돼요. 와 주셔서 감사합니다. 좋은 밤 되세요!

vocab.meaning: 창가에 앉다 (seat가 아니라 sit, the 필수)

vocab.example: I'd like a glass of beer, please.
I'd like a seafood salad with that, please.
